== Summary ==
[[Ryan Morris]] and [[Mark Tuttle]], the hosts of Radio Free DecipherCon, Decipher's audio feed at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999). Decipher's caption: "Meet Ryan Morris and Mark Tuttle! - the voice and tech behind Radio Free DecipherCon." The Friday photo page captions the same pair: "Ryan Morris and Mark Tuttle, the men behind the voices of Radio Free DecipherCon." Neither caption says who is on the left or right. Left (headphones, thumbs-up): [[Ryan Morris]]; right (red lanyard, watch): [[Mark Tuttle]]. The left/right identification is Bill Bisco's, confirmed 26 October 2026. Crops: [[:File:Ryan Morris DecipherCon 1999.png]], [[:File:Mark Tuttle DecipherCon 1999.png]]. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Radio Free Decipher]].
